Technical note: validation record

Source: vignettes/technical-note-validation.qmd

This note indexes the validation evidence kept in the repository under docs/reports/, and states what each item supports and does not support.

Topic Report Supports
Calibration of MBCO and model bootstrap CALIBRATION-2026-10-14.md Nominal MBCO coverage off the double null; conservative at it; model bootstrap by design
MBCO near the double null MBCO-NULL-T5-FEASIBILITY-2026-10-14.md A calibrated cutoff was not found; the interval stays conservative
MBCO optimizer MBCO-OPTIMIZER-REVIEW-2026-10-14.md Exact constraint elimination; optimizers agree to about 1e-11
Coverage claims in the manuscript PMED-COVERAGE-CLAIMS-CHECK-2026-10-14.md Percentile intervals carry Monte Carlo inflation
Exact Gaussian reference I2-EXACT-REFERENCE-2026-10-15.md, AUDIT-exact-gaussian-hopper-2026-10-20.md Exact-Gaussian run passed its original six-cell rule
Gaussian candidate gate I6-GATE-2026-10-19.md Candidate d failed the frozen coverage-equivalence and width gates
Wasserstein repairs VALIDATE-wasserstein-*-2026-10-20.md Boundary correction, selection, joint contrast and observed inference checks
Ecosystem compatibility tasks/plan-mediationverse-compat.md Suite passes on medfit 0.3.2 (CRAN) and 0.12.0 (r-universe), 832 tests each; 0.4.1 fixed a missing-value guard that medfit 0.10+ bypassed
Boundary point risk REPORT-boundary-point-risk-2026-10-21.md Negative result; see below

Boundary behavior in one paragraph

For the binary-outcome Wasserstein proportion mediated, the plug-in bias at an exactly zero path is of order n−1/4n^{-1/4}. The frozen bias gate (|bias|/SD below .10) cannot be met by any estimator with values in [0, 1] in the zero-direct and weak-direct cells at n = 500. A two-point floor on maximum RMSE is about .09 (direct) and .07 (indirect) at n = 500. Five reference estimators failed the author’s RMSE tolerances. The supported uncertainty statement is the Fieller interval, which passed coverage in every archived binary cell.

What this record does not show

It does not show that no estimator could meet the tolerances; the floor lies below them. It does not clear the author’s scientific hold on the boundary diagnostics, and it does not authorize a CRAN or manuscript submission.

Reproducing

Scripts live in scripts/ (check-boundary-*.R, check-gate-*.R, pilot-reference-estimators.R). Set VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 and OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 before running forked simulations, or the workers stall on BLAS threads.
